sources.entry: Product Hunt - share and discover your favorite new products and applications.

summary.one_liner: Official macOS client for Product Hunt, the site for discovering new tech products, apps, books, games, and podcasts.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes this as the official Product Hunt app for Mac, positioned as a place to discover new products across tech, books, games, and podcasts. It is an Xcode project (open via Product Hunt.xcworkspace) that uses CocoaPods for dependencies. Developers clone the repo, copy a Keys-Example.xcconfig template to Keys.xcconfig, and add API keys generated from Product Hunt's developer site. The README also links a download for the packaged Mac app and mentions the company's iOS app and Chrome extension. Contribution steps are standard fork-branch-PR, with a note to run tests. The README gives no feature list beyond this.
use_cases: browse daily tech launches on a Mac
study a macOS app built with CocoaPods
contribute to the Product Hunt Mac client
how_to_run: Generate API keys (link in README) and add them to Keys.xcconfig
notable: Official Product Hunt client for macOS
Requires user-generated API keys via a Keys.xcconfig template
Also available as a direct download per the README
Covers products, books, games, and podcasts on Product Hunt
caveats: README gives no feature list or screenshots, and the API key link is not included in the text
Building requires generating your own API keys and running pod install
Setup details beyond the listed steps are not documented
